text: U.S. stock markets are trading in a mixed fashion today, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average edging higher while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite have slipped as tech-sector pressure offsets optimism from cooling geopolitical tensions. The market is reacting to a pause in hostilities between the U.S. and Iran, which has sent oil prices sharply lower and provided a boost to broader sentiment, even as investors remain cautious ahead of a busy week of corporate earnings and a Federal Reserve policy decision. Communications and consumer defensive stocks are currently leading the market, while the technology and energy sectors are lagging due to renewed artificial intelligence valuation concerns and the decline in oil prices.
